answers.M6-S1: When you really want something, you can believe things that are not true and get tricked.
answers.M6-S2: Because Billy said if he tells anybody, the magic seed will not work anymore.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks the seed is really magic and Billy is being nice, but the reader can tell Billy is probably tricking him for money.
answers.M6-S4: He felt really grateful to Billy and wanted to like him more, so he said yes and paid him right away.
answers.M6-S5: Because he got so tall from the seed that it scared him away from her, and it makes the seed sound special.
answers.M6-S6: It shows he measured himself for a few days and then started taking the seed, so we wonder if it will work.
answers.M6-S7: To show that because Billy was so tall, he went to the witch and got the magic seed.
answers.M6-S8: That people did not really like Billy that much, so maybe he is not a very good or honest person.
answers.M6-S9: He likes his uncle a lot but he does not want to be short like him. He wants to grow taller.
